Name: Seiton Sense

Description: A local PvP HUD integrating pressure and CC-protection cues, Ninja Seiton decisions, personal and MCH LB warnings, opt-in CC macro utilities, emergency cleanses, experimental WHM Miracle intercepts, and target highlights.
Changelog: Adds an opt-in experimental CC-only WHM Miracle intercept for exact early MCH Marksman's Spite, SAM Zantetsuken, and VPR Furious Backlash / Nest der Blutschuppen signals. One eligible physical key generation can make one exact 10y/LoS Miracle attempt with Purify and Ally Rescue priority, no target switch, fallback, or retry. MCH/SAM opportunities last 500ms; VPR lasts 250ms and waits for Hardened Scales to be truly absent. Live validation remains required.
